author: whateverdawg
quote: A GTA fan is not here for a simp Simulator. The graphics and all are amazing and feels so alive but this story is not worth it. They want to be realistic but you can’t kill in certain clubs or certain NPC’s and in other places you can? You want it to be realistic? THEN LET US DO WHATEVER WE WANT that’s core in GTA. Too much realism is not fun. simping around making lucia happy how the hell is that fun???13 years with this much money you aren’t allowed to have so many bugs and glitches, 30fps which sometimes drops to 20 bro what!! The characters in GTA5 had interesting different personalities and kept me wanting to know more about them made me laugh and be shocked the next moment.. Lucia is so annoying like damn get her out of there i’m not here to go shopping for her? NOBODY CARES! you’re lying when you say building a house and going grocery shopping for someone like her is fun just go play sims at this point. For those who say “we are here for online story is not that deep” what are you  talking about? every GTA game was so good because not only of the open world but especially the story and the vibe! Everybody knows CJ, Big Smoke, Niko, Trevor etc. with some  legendary **** many will remember or give a single F about Lucia and Jason. Cyberpunk got buried after release and on GTA6 you give it a pass and ignore it not even mentioning it? Lol y’all 100 and 10 reviewers are joking. let me say that the other critics is absurd. imagine saying “the game is not perfect” while giving it a 100 like what?? That’s hypocritical rigged **** game is fun but your sense of critical thinking is a joke. Most games do amazing graphics etc. but it takes more than that to be 10/10. 13 years.. of course fans expected more!! But taking many core things away is sad. Still it’s very fun and realistic and huge there is so much to do at least but not perfect to be 99.

author: whateverdawg
quote: Metareviews dropping it to 95 is hating for no reason. If it gets robbed by GTA for GOTY then it’s a bad joke. The legend of zelda ocarina of time is literally timeless and the remake crazy beautiful, 60fps, great details, perfect atmosphere, music, creative, sooooo much fun.. i mean we already know how amazing the original game is and this remake doesn’t miss AT ALL. It is a MASTERPIECE simple as that. I didn’t want it to end and playing an ocarina in real life for the game? Amazing. It’s 100% worth it and not for nothing the greatest game of all time that changed Videogames forever.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
